scoring_justification: All required properties are recomputed from raw artifacts against paper values with tolerances; T1 feasible.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for structural, vibrational, and electronic properties of model c120_15ps (120 atoms, 1.50 g/cm³) from the paper Table 1 and supporting text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Accepted manuscript Table 1 and description: coordination 2.90, sp2=81.67%, sp3=4.17%, sp=14.16%, RDF peaks 1.45, 2.49 Å, Dulong-Petit limit 24.94 J/(mol·K), VDOS features, EDOS pseudogap and p-dominance.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's manuscript; no transformation.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published values for the target model; they serve as the gold standard for reproduction.

schema.description: XYZ format: first line N; second line comment (cell vectors); next N lines each 'C x y z' in Angstrom.

outputs.description: Relaxed atomic structure of the 120-atom amorphous carbon model at 1.50 g/cm³. Checker recomputes coordination and hybridization fractions.

schema.description: One floating-point eigenfrequency per line in cm⁻¹, sorted ascending, 3N-3 lines.

outputs.description: Vibrational eigenfrequencies used to compute VDOS and harmonic specific heat; checker checks shape and Dulong-Petit limit.
Radial distribution function g(r) table; checker verifies first and second peak positions within tolerance.
Electronic density of states; checker inspects Fermi-level pseudogap and p-orbital dominance.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are derived from the same ab initio melt-quench simulation of step_01. The agent is free to choose any open-source plane-wave DFT implementation and specific run parameters (timestep, thermostat, k-point sampling, etc.), provided the overall 15 ps cooling from 8000 K to 300 K and final relaxation are achieved. No gold values or tolerances are public.

steps.description: Recompute mean coordination and sp/sp2/sp3 fractions from the structure using a bond cutoff of 1.85 Å and compare to hidden paper values.

Gaussian broaden eigenfrequencies (σ=3 meV) to obtain VDOS, verify harmonic specific heat Cv(300 K) approaches Dulong-Petit limit, and check VDOS shape features (broad band below 200 meV, feature near 50 meV).
Locate the first and second RDF peak positions and verify they are 1.45±0.05 Å and 2.49±0.05 Å.
Check that total DOS exhibits a pseudogap around the Fermi level and that p-projected DOS dominates near the conduction edge.
